主要内容: Waters Corporation announced its results of operations for the quarter and year ended December 31, 2018. The Company also announced that its Board of Directors elected to terminate the existing share repurchase program, which had $2.3 billion remaining as of January 21, 2019, and authorize a new repurchase program under which the Company may repurchase up to $4 billion of its outstanding common stock over a two-year period in either open market or private transactions. The size and timing of these purchases will depend on price, market, and business conditions and other factors. A copy of the related press release is attached as Exhibit 99.1 to this Form 8-K and is incorporated by reference in its entirety. The press release was dated January 23, 2019, and the Company's Chief Financial Officer, Sherry L. Buck, signed the report on behalf of the Registrant on January 23, 2019.
